items.title: Dell Stock's Massive Guidance Raise Has A Catch
items.summary: Management put a stunning new number on its full-year earnings, and the market is buying the story. But the real question is whether this is a new era of growth or customers pulling forward tomorrow's demand into today.

items.title: Arista Networks Stock Looks Strong. One Number Says Be Careful.
items.summary: The company's AI story is a powerful one, but its long-term success hinges on a single customer metric worth watching closely as the easy growth phase ends.

items.title: SanDisk Stock Is On Sale, But Is The Company's New Strategy The Real Story?
items.summary: The memory chip maker is rewriting its own rulebook, and for investors eyeing the recent pullback, that's the real decision to weigh.

items.title: SMCI's Backlogs are Growing at a Record Pace: What's Ahead?
items.summary: Super Micro Computer's record backlog and AI demand set the stage for growth, with management expecting AI solutions to exceed 80% of revenues.

items.title: Super Micro Surges 8% as Taiwan Indicts Employees but Not the Company, Dell Climbs 4%
items.summary: A Taiwanese indictment named individuals tied to Super Micro and NVIDIA, but whether the companies themselves face liability depends on a legal distinction that sent one stock soaring 8% while the broader tech tape went nowhere.

items.title: Bet on These 5 Dividend Growth Stocks Ahead of NVIDIA's Q2 Earnings Report
items.summary: Dividend-growth stocks may offer stability as investors rotate from high-valuation tech, with five names standing out on growth, cash flow and payouts.

items.title: 1 Value Stock with Impressive Fundamentals and 2 We Find Risky
items.summary: Value stocks typically trade at discounts to the broader market, offering patient investors the opportunity to buy businesses when they’re out of favor. The key risk, however, is that these stocks are usually cheap for a reason, and a low valuation can reflect underlying business challenges rather than a genuine bargain.

items.title: Cisco Grows Into Its Multiple, And The Market Has To Do The Rest
items.summary: Consensus has the earnings arriving, and the multiple falling, yet the scenario that follows leaves a holder within a few percent of today's price unless the market goes on paying a richer forward multiple than it does today.
